signals.summary: Nanaya Shiki is identified as Tohno Shiki's original name before taking the Tohno surname.
The name can refer to young Shiki, Shiki under Nanaya demon-hunter blood agitation, Shiki's imagined killer aspect, or a relatively independent killer manifested by TATARI.
In the original version, he appears through TATARI as Shiki's fear and unease about his own inversion impulse reflected by Night of Wallachia.

The source says speech suggests Nanaya may use Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, but later author comment says he does not; ability support is therefore cautionary and not promoted as a formal ability fact here.
No standalone appearance, outfit, or combat-effect detail for Nanaya Shiki is present in the Stage 1 excerpt beyond identity/variant/TATARI context.
